content.en: As the deafening blast of rock music filled the air, the puppets charging forward suddenly faltered.
content.zh: 伴随着摇滚曲震耳欲聋的响声，人偶原本飞速前冲的动作忽然磕绊了起来。

content.en: Page swung the fire extinguisher toward them and pressed the handle. A cloud of white mist, a mix of dry ice particles and vapor, burst forth.
content.zh: 周书猛地将灭火器中对准前方冲来的人偶们，按下了压把。干冰微粒与水汽混合而成的白雾瞬间弥漫开来。

content.en: Veris saw Page dart through the fog with inhuman speed, swiftly knocking down the stiff puppets one after another.
content.zh: 何以真看到周书以远超常人所及的速度在白雾间翻腾，几下便将僵硬地人偶们统统踹倒在地。

content.en: When the mist gradually cleared, only the toppled puppets lay across the cabin floor — and Page stood tall at the front, fierce and unshaken.
content.zh: 待到白雾缓缓散去时，舱室中只剩下躺了满地的人偶，与立在最前方、英姿飒爽的周书。
